messages:
From: Laura Benson <laura.benson@genomicshealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: security@genomicshealth.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0500
Subject: Archer partial ingest + CAIQ mapping

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We agreed the fastest path for our procurement/legal review is to get a minimal Archer profile populated so our internal security team can run the CAIQ comparison. We don't need a full Whistic export — just a scoped profile with:

- SOC 2 attestation snapshot (latest)
- CAIQ answers for the 35 fields flagged in our intake (attached list)
- Key artifacts: SOC 2 report cover page, encryption diagram, data retention table

Can your team do a partial ingest into Archer and share a mapping of which Archer fields will be filled vs left empty? A simple CSV mapping + an evidence manifest (filenames + short descriptions) would be ideal — that will let our GRC team triage quickly.

Target timeline: evidence posted to Archer by EOD Tuesday 24 Nov if possible (we're trying to close procurement by end of month). Let me know constraints.

Appreciate it —
Laura
Laura Benson
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
GenomicsHealth, Inc.
laura.benson@genomicshealth.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Laura Benson <laura.benson@genomicshealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Archer partial ingest + CAIQ mapping

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can support a scoped Archer profile for the 35 CAIQ fields. Plan below — estimating completion by COB Tuesday but will flag blockers immediately: 

1) Quick intake & mapping (today) — Karthik to map your 35 fields to Archer field IDs and mark which require new artifacts. Output: caiaq-field-map.csv (included).
2) Evidence manifest creation (today) — I will assemble the filenames and short descriptions into evidence-manifest-v1.xlsx.
3) Partial ingest to Archer (tomorrow) — We will post answers + attach artifacts to the relevant Archer items. We'll mark all unpopulated fields with a short rationale (e.g., "third-party controls", "N/A - not applicable to hosted API").
4) Deliverable & verification (Tue EOD) — link to profile + CSV mapping + manifest.

Note: SOC 2 report full PDF cannot be uploaded to Archer due to size/PII policy; we'll upload the cover page + a secure DocuSign/Drive link to the full report and list the access controls in the manifest. If GenomicsHealth prefers a different handling, flag it.

I've attached the initial mapping and the ingest playbook draft for your review. Karthik — can you confirm any Archer field constraints we should be aware of (e.g., max length on "control description", allowed file types)? Mina — please confirm which artifacts we must redact before upload per our legal guidelines.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Security Operations
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

[attachments: archer_partial_ingest_plan_v1.pdf, caiaq-field-map.csv, evidence-manifest-v1.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Laura Benson <laura.benson@genomicshealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Archer partial ingest + CAIQ mapping

Thanks — quick notes from the field-mapping review: 

- Archer has a 2,000 character limit on "control description" and strips HTML; we'll paste plaintext.
- File uploads: PDF, PNG, JPG accepted. 20MB limit per file. For large SOC reports we'll include a signed access link (DocuSign/Drive) in the artifact notes.
- There's no native "evidence tagging" for CAIQ vector; we'll add the CAIQ field ID into the "external_ref" field so your team can programmatically map answers back.

I updated caiaq-field-map.csv with Archer field IDs and a "notes" column that flags which artifacts are mandatory vs optional. Also flagged 3 fields that are control-level (require policy + evidence) — those will need a short policy snippet; Sofia, can you confirm who will write those snippets? I can draft them if helpful (I've done similar for other portals).

I'll be online for the ingest tomorrow morning and can run the import.

—Karthik
Sr. Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
